Refs KS-2179
Refs KS-1398
Refs KS-2136

Ticket: https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-2179/ks-1398-step-one-l7-sdkjavascript-gets-a-tsconfig-a-standalone-lock

## What this changes

KS-1398 step one, lane L7 (TypeScript 7 preparation). `Blockchain/Dev/sdk/javascript` had no tsconfig and no lock, and `npm run build` failed at its declaration step (`src/client.ts(8,73): error TS2792: Cannot find module 'axios'`), so no `dist/index.d.ts` was written. This PR adds `tsconfig.json` and a standalone `package-lock.json`, edits `package.json`, and adds a docs fragment pair. It changes no TypeScript version, no `src/` file, no README, no workspace manifest and no root lock. Nothing publishes this package.

Each of these is its own item:

1. **Emitter.** `build` is now `tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm && tsc -p tsconfig.json`: tsup writes the JavaScript and `tsc` (emitDeclarationOnly) writes seven declaration files (entry `dist/index.d.ts`). tsup's own declaration step (8.5.1 and 9.0.0) crashes on TypeScript 7.0.2; this route builds on 5.9.3 and 7.0.2 and writes the same bytes. `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs` are byte for byte equal to the build before this change: the tsconfig lists the strict flags one by one and leaves out `strict`, because `strict` implies `alwaysStrict`, the one flag that adds a `"use strict";` prologue to `index.js`.
2. **eslint devDependency and the non-functional lint script removed:** the only non-baseline route to a passing `audit:locks` on the new lock (minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 via eslint 10, no patched 10.x); restoring lint is filed separately. The `lint` script (`eslint src/`) already exited 2 (no eslint config in the package).
3. **tsup moved to `^9.0.0`:** clears esbuild GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr; tsup is now the JS bundler only.
4. **`dev` drops `--dts`:** `tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --watch` (its own item; the declaration step is `tsc`'s now).
5. **vitest `^1.0.4` to `^4.1.12`** (the repo's ruled line; the old range carried 3 critical advisories).
6. **KS-2136 folded in:** `test` is `vitest --passWithNoTests`, so a package with no test files exits 0 instead of 1.
7. **Docs:** one fragment per page (`Projects Documents/fragments/{flow,cheat}/KS-2179-sdk-javascript-declarations-by-tsc-on-typescript-5-and-7.html`).

## Test Evidence

Develop `b7137aa97c79`, branch cut on it. TypeScript 5.9.3 in the tree; Node v26.8.1 (not an LTS line) and npm 11.19.0; Apple M2, shared with other sessions; 2026-11-12 (UTC).

**Touched:** `Blockchain/Dev/sdk/javascript/{package.json (12 lines: 5 added, 7 removed), tsconfig.json (new), package-lock.json (new, 193 entries, lockfileVersion 3)}` and the two fragment files. `git diff --stat`: 5 files, 3,131 insertions, 7 deletions. The root `package-lock.json` is byte-equal before and after (sha256 `80b45c604bb34c1d`).

**Ran:**

| Check | Before (develop) | After |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run build` in `sdk/javascript` | rc 1 (TS2792), `dist` holds `index.js` 15,835 B and `index.mjs` 13,804 B | rc 0; `dist` holds 9 files |
| `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.mjs` | sha256 `551d6628a5ff57e7`, `eb73d12947e99715` | equal, both |
| `dist/*.d.ts` | none | `index.d.ts` 2,212 B, `client.d.ts` 2,833 B, `modules/{certifications,governance,kyc,transfers,webhooks}.d.ts` 3,402 / 3,417 / 2,402 / 3,799 / 3,472 B |
| `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (5.9.3) | no tsconfig | rc 0, 0 diagnostics |
| public names of `src/index.ts` in `dist/index.d.ts` | n/a | 10 of 10 |
| consumer check (one-file consumer through `types`/`exports`: node16 CommonJS, node16 ES module, bundler) | n/a | rc 0 in all 3 |
| `npm test` (CI=true; the package has no test files) | rc 1 | rc 0, "No test files found, exiting with code 0" |
| `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in `sdk/javascript` | no lock | rc 0, 111 packages, lock unchanged |
| `npm run audit:locks` (47 tracked locks, 45 scanned) | a new lock on today's manifest: rc 1, 14 advisories; with vitest `^4.1.12` only: rc 1, 2 advisories | rc 0: `OK — no standalone-lock advisories outside the triaged baseline.` |
| `npm run audit:gate` | n/a | rc 0: `audit-gate: 5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined.` then `OK — no advisories outside the triaged baseline.` |
| `docs-fragments.mjs check` | n/a | OK (lint clean, render passes); a planted unclosed `<div>` turned it red (rc 1), restored by sha256, green again |

**Planted controls that fired:** one byte changed in a copy of `dist/index.js` reads unequal to the before file; deleting one export line from `src/index.ts` in a scratch clone drops the names in `dist/index.d.ts` from 10 to 8; a failing test file in a scratch clone turns `npm test` rc 1; a wrong expected count in the edit tool was refused.

**TypeScript 7.0.2 in a scratch clone (a measurement, not a gate; nothing installed in this tree):** `typescript@7.0.2` installed with `--save-exact --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts`; `npm run build` rc 0, `dist` 9 files, byte for byte equal to the 5.9.3 build (9 of 9); `tsc --noEmit` rc 0; consumer check rc 0 in all 3 modes. For contrast, tsup `--dts` on 7.0.2 exits 1 (8.5.1: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'useCaseSensitiveFileNames')`; 9.0.0: `rollup-plugin-dts requires the TypeScript compiler API`).

**NOT run / not covered:** unit tests of any other package (nothing outside `sdk/javascript` and the two fragments changed); a real `npm publish` or an `npm pack` consumer install; the sdk's lint (removed, to be restored separately); a container build of the lock (the Docker daemon was down: the lock was written by host npm 11.19.0 with the repo's own command, `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-workspaces`); Node 24 (the project's LTS line); the four platform suites (Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright, k6). This is a form change that builds on TypeScript 5.9.3 and 7.0.2 in scratch; it is not a proven cure for the step-five flip.

**Migrations and config:** none. No environment variable, no root file, no workspace manifest.

**Pre-push hook:** "[pre-push] Blockchain/Dev changes detected → running preflight gate", then "PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE — 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED. Nothing failed." Legs 3, 4 and 8 skipped (the local stack was not up). Leg 1 OK (spec in sync). Leg 2 clean-room-installed 35 of the 47 tracked locks and did NOT install this package's lock (it is on that leg's "NOT installed" list; my own `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in `sdk/javascript` exited 0). Leg 6 OK (`audit-gate: 5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined.`); leg 7 OK (`audit-locks: 45 standalone lockfiles`, no advisory outside the baseline). Leg 14: 127 shell suites passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (1036 s). Leg 16: five services, 0 new. This is not a pass; it says which legs ran.
